title: Jagged Pungent Brazilian Sausage Skewers
description: A flavorful and adventurous Brazilian dish featuring pungent sausage, served in agave leaves. This recipe is nut-free and features a unique blend of spices.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the Brazilian sausage into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the sausage pieces.
Thread the sausage pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the skewers, if desired.
Place an agave leaf on a flat surface and brush the center of the leaf with olive oil.
Place a skewer in the center of the agave leaf and fold the leaf over the skewer to form a packet.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients and agave leaves.
Grill the packets for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sausage is cooked through and the agave leaf is slightly charred.
